reviews.author: Angelo G
reviews.title: Awesome Resort
reviews.text:
We went on a family vacation with young kiddos. 

The service was great (shout out to Sergio and Fernanda). The resort just went through a major renovation so everything looked relatively well managed. As usual with Mexico, you’ll notice the areas that see little light of day are not well cared for. But overall the resort is very nice

Not all restaurants are the same quality. Capella is great and the best for family. I thought the others were mediocre and zesty was not good at all. 

Buffet is hit and miss. Some days are good, others not great. 

Definitely go for the ice cream, it’s really good. Go for the Fero to hero ice cream, it’s really good. 

Now for the minuses-

Juice bar was great but for some ungodly reason, the workers there thought it was a good idea to add water to juice and to sweeten it, add sugar. Once I saw that, I stopped drinking juice. 

The kids swimming pool area has some slides but only for kids. Parents aren’t allowed to go up the stairs. 

So if they tighten up their buffet/juice bar. Add more slides or atleast allow adults to enjoy the slides with the kids, I would give it a 5 star rating

reviews.author: Loomy
reviews.title: AMAZINGGGG
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Our family just returned from an incredible 11 night stay at Paradisus Cancun, and we are already talking about when we can come back!
What truly made this vacation unforgettable was the amazing staff. A huge thank you to Bernardo, Armando, Pascual, Alejandro, and Seferino from the Gastro Hall. They welcomed us every day with genuine kindness and warmth and truly made us feel at home. Their service was exceptional, and seeing their friendly faces became one of our favorite parts of each day.
A special shout-out to Anna, the bartender closest to Aqua Marina. She was absolutely wonderful—always friendly, attentive, and making delicious drinks with a smile.
We also want to recognize the entertainment team, especially Mauricio, Daniel, and Giovani. They made the most fun crafts and activities for our family and helped create memories that our children will be talking about for a long time.
Our concierge, Faredeh, was fantastic. She helped coordinate all of our dinner reservations and made everything seamless from start to finish. Her attention to detail and willingness to help made our stay stress-free and enjoyable.
We also want to give a special thank you to Ivan from Guest Services. He truly made our whole trip by taking the time to come say hi and chat with us whenever he saw us around the resort. His friendliness and genuine interest in making sure we were having a great time made us feel incredibly welcome and added a personal touch that meant so much to our family.
The food throughout the resort was excellent, with plenty of variety and something for everyone. Our favorite restaurant was the Italian restaurant—we looked forward to every meal there! We also can’t forget Norma at the coffee shop, who always greeted us with a smile and made every morning a little brighter.
The housekeeping team was outstanding, servicing our room twice daily and keeping everything spotless. The pools were always clean, the grounds were beautiful, and every staff member we encountered was helpful, professional, and genuinely cared about making our vacation special.
Thank you, Paradisus Cancun, for helping our family create wonderful memories. We felt welcomed, cared for, and appreciated throughout our stay. We cannot wait to return!

My family and I had an amazing time. The service at the hotel was excellent. We believe that for an all-inclusive, the food offerings are important, and this hotel does not disappoint. The service of
The kids' club is fantastic; I would like to especially mention Maylin, Esme, and Gypsy for their attentiveness to my little one, as he had a truly happy vacation at the club. reviews.author: Rocio P
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancún (Renovated)
reviews.text:
The Blue Agave restaurant has an exquisite menu. Fanny, the manager, was always attentive to ensure we were perfectly taken care of, and Armando, the waiter, provided exceptional service, being very attentive to every detail and making menu recommendations. His service was very pleasant and he was very attentive to every detail; highly recommended, thank you very much.
At the Santé restaurant, Cinthia's attention is extraordinary; she fulfilled our menu requests. Seferino, likewise, with his warm and punctual service supported our stay, and Ángel in the kitchen provided us with exquisite flavors. Congratulations.
The Zesty restaurant has a different but delicious concept. Roberto, the waiter, was very attentive, expanded the information about the food and drinks, and provided efficient service, always attentive to every detail of our new dinner. Fanny, the manager, gave us a warm welcome and was always attentive to our requests, always with her characteristic kindness. Thank you.
The hotel buffet, Gastro Hall, has a variety of exquisite dishes, all in perfect order, and the service from the waiters was exceptional. On this occasion, Alberto attended to us excellently, being very attentive to every need.
At the taco grill, Ramiro delighted us with some tacos and a delicious habanero salsa.
We discovered the Sal restaurant, the gem of this hotel. Antonio and Alejandra warmly welcomed us and guided us to our table. The cuts of meat are served to the requested doneness, with the chosen side dish. Roger has been an excellent host as our waiter, offering us various amenities. Likewise, Emmanuel quickly fulfilled a request we made; thank you very much. We congratulate the chef and grillers for their exquisite seasoning.
It was very pleasant to greet David, the chef, once again, with whom we have previously coincided at the Mexican restaurant, who today is part of the Sal team.
On a later visit to the Blue Agave restaurant, Chef David kindly brought us two tastings of ingredients used in his kitchen. He explained the process to obtain them and how he includes them in the dishes; it was a delicious experience.
At the Ginger bar, we reunited with Karina, who recognized us instantly. She greeted us and invited us to try some of the drinks they offer. The music creates an excellent atmosphere, and despite having so much work, Karina is very attentive to all the guests, which is appreciated because it ensures that no one runs out of drinks.
At the Kao restaurant, David, the waiter, suggested a tasting of appetizers so we could get to know the menu, which is delicious by the way. The drinks and service were excellent and, above all, very quick; he remained attentive at all times.
At the Gastro Hall, Bernardo, the waiter, is super attentive and helpful.
Guillermo, the manager of the Yhi Spa, was very kind and offered us great promotions in the pool area, explaining the details of the massage very well. He was very attentive to every detail, even during our visit inside the spa.
Catalina, the massage therapist, performed an incredible relaxation massage; on the other hand, Ruth guided us in hydrotherapy, being very careful and detail-oriented, providing us with everything necessary to create a different experience.
At the Cappela restaurant, Jesús is an exceptional waiter because despite the number of people he had to serve, he was extremely attentive to every detail and never stopped addressing our needs.
Flor from the Ginger bar is always very attentive to serving us and keeping the place organized.
Julio at The Reserve bar is a magnificent host; since our last visit to the hotel, he has been extremely kind, helpful, and pleasant in his manner. Thank you very much for your enthusiasm.
The breakfast at the Gastro Hall is a delight. Armando, as our waiter once again, was extremely attentive, helpful, and very mindful of each of our requests. It is a pleasure to greet him again. His charisma creates a pleasant atmosphere among the guests.
Our entire stay was enjoyable thanks to Carolina and Erick, our concierges, who immediately established effective communication with us, provided us with timely information, addressed all our questions and requests, and accompanied us to hear about our experience in person. Thank you very much. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED

reviews.author: M F
reviews.title: They are better resorts in Cancun
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at this resort with a group of nearly 20 family members to celebrate my father’s 85th birthday and our engagement. Family traveled from both Canada and the UK for this special occasion, and we booked six rooms well in advance. Unfortunately, the experience fell far short of expectations.

The check-in process was extremely long and disorganized. Despite being in contact with the resort multiple times before arrival regarding our group booking, there was still confusion with room assignments. Most of our family received their rooms, but I was initially assigned a room that was already occupied, which was particularly concerning as my key still worked for that room. While the issue was eventually resolved, it was not a great start to our vacation.

Room-related issues were widespread throughout our group. My parents experienced a significant leak that soaked their clothes and suitcases. As compensation, they were offered one complimentary night for a future stay at the same resort, which was of little value given our experience. Our cousin’s room had both a leak and a cockroach, another family’s air conditioning was not working properly, and another room’s fridge was not cooling. Our own room was clean, but the minibar was barely stocked and inconsistently replenished throughout our stay. Considering we booked six rooms, it was disappointing how many guests experienced maintenance issues.

We had informed the resort multiple times both before and during our stay that we were celebrating an engagement and an 85th birthday, yet there was no acknowledgment whatsoever—not even a small cake, dessert, card, or room decoration.

This contrast is especially striking because we have stayed at other resorts in Cancun and know the level of service that is possible. During a previous stay at the Royalton CHIC Cancun, I celebrated a milestone birthday, and the staff went above and beyond throughout my entire stay. They made the day feel special with thoughtful touches such as wine, chocolates, and personalized room amenities, which made me feel genuinely valued as a guest.

Dining was another challenge. With a group of nearly 20 people, securing reservations was almost impossible. The only way we were able to dine together was by paying an additional $15 USD per person for one evening. Given the significance of the celebration, we expected more flexibility and accommodation.

As for the food, if you’re a foodie, this may not be the resort for you. The Italian restaurant was the standout meal of the trip, while most other dining options were average and forgettable. The ice cream shop was excellent, and the coffee was good depending on who was preparing it.

Another ongoing issue was the lack of available seating at both the pool and beach. Guests had to wake up very early to secure chairs; otherwise, there was little chance of finding a spot later in the day.

The frustrations continued even after we returned home. A deposit charged to one of our family members’ credit cards was never properly reversed. What should have been a simple fix took approximately six weeks to resolve, with multiple follow-ups, transfers between departments, and emails to different contacts before the issue was finally addressed.

While this resort was not terrible, it did not deliver the level of service, accommodations, or experience we expected for such an important family celebration. Between the room issues, poor organization, lack of recognition for special occasions, difficulty securing dinner reservations, limited seating at the pool and beach, mediocre food, and frustrating post-stay customer service, we left disappointed and would not return.

reviews.author: Mark
reviews.title: A disappointing stay
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancún has some genuinely positive qualities. The pool areas are attractive and well maintained, the grounds are impressive, and the hotel enjoys a beautiful location on a lovely stretch of beach. Unfortunately, despite these strengths, the overall guest experience fell well below expectations.

The biggest issue was the lack of sleep. Our room had a faulty air-conditioning unit that produced a loud screeching noise throughout the night. Engineers attended twice, but the problem continued every night of our stay.

To make matters worse, loud music from the hotel lobby could be clearly heard in our room throughout the night. On one occasion it was still playing at around 3:30am, forcing us to call reception. We were told it would be turned off, but instead the music continued and remained clearly audible within our room.

The room also contained flashing lights from a faulty fitting and large Wi-Fi routers mounted directly above the beds, creating a constant flashing light effect throughout the night. We even attempted to cover them ourselves in order to sleep.

By the third day, the cumulative effect of the noise, flashing lights and lack of sleep had left us exhausted and unable to properly enjoy the holiday.

Equally disappointing was the all-inclusive offering. Several restaurants were closed during the evenings and even the main buffet restaurant was closed on two occasions during our four-night stay. Dining options were therefore significantly reduced from what had been advertised.

There also appeared to be a lack of evening social spaces for guests. For a resort of this size and positioning, there were surprisingly few bars or comfortable seating areas where guests could gather, enjoy a drink and socialise during the evening. Once dining options became limited, there was very little atmosphere or provision for guests wishing to spend time together outside their rooms. The resort would benefit from a review of its evening facilities and social areas to better meet guest expectations.

The main hotel building also felt surprisingly commercial in character. Rather than creating the atmosphere of a luxury resort, much of the central area resembled a shopping mall, with retail outlets and open public spaces dominating the environment. This detracted from the relaxing and premium ambience that many guests are likely expecting when booking a resort under the Paradisus brand.

What was most frustrating was that these issues were reported daily. Despite repeated complaints and engineer visits, very little changed. We spent far too much of our holiday chasing solutions rather than relaxing.

I also found it disappointing that when I spoke with the hotel’s sales manager about the ongoing problems, the conversation repeatedly shifted towards selling the Meliá Circle membership programme rather than addressing our concerns as paying guests.

Many other guests appeared to be expressing similar frustrations during our stay, and the overall impression was that the resort is still struggling following its recent refurbishment and is not yet operating at the level expected of a premium all-inclusive destination.

For a resort positioned and priced as a premium all-inclusive destination, the gap between expectation and reality was simply too great.

The setting, grounds and beach are undoubtedly attractive, but sadly the guest experience fell well short of expectations. Until the operational issues, service standards, evening facilities and overnight noise problems are properly addressed, I would struggle to recommend Paradisus Cancún to anyone looking for a relaxing luxury holiday.

reviews.author: Tomika28
reviews.title: Second time at Paradisus
reviews.text:
A very honest review. 

This was our second stay at Paradisus Cancun, with our first visit being in March 2023. We enjoyed our first stay enough to return, so I feel I can give a fair and honest comparison.

The first thing I have to say is that this resort is absolutely beautiful. The grounds are stunning and impeccably maintained. Throughout our entire stay, staff were constantly working to keep the landscaping pristine and the property spotless. The resort itself feels luxurious, clean, and very well cared for. Even though many of the common areas are open-air and not air-conditioned, there is usually a nice breeze that keeps things comfortable. I also appreciated the size of the resort—large enough to offer plenty of amenities, but not so large that you feel lost trying to get around.

The renovated rooms are beautiful, especially the bathrooms, which are modern, stylish, and very aesthetically pleasing. My only complaint is the lack of storage space. As a family of four, we found it difficult to unpack and organize our belongings. There are only a few hangers and a couple of drawers available. The previous TV stand with additional storage appears to have been removed, and the room would benefit greatly from having more space for clothing and personal items.

As for the food, I want to be honest. The resort was only about 30% occupied during our stay, so that may have affected the offerings. Unfortunately, the lunch and dinner buffet were disappointing. Variety was limited, and the children's section was especially lacking. Most days, the only options for kids were macaroni and cheese and chicken nuggets, often without even fries. Breakfast, however, was excellent. There was a great selection of fresh fruit, healthy options, and everything always tasted fresh and well prepared.

The restaurants were much better than the buffet. Blue Agave was one of our favorites for dinner—the food was fantastic. Lunch, however, was a different story. The tacos we ordered were not enjoyable, and we barely touched them. Cappella was another standout, with a beautiful atmosphere and very good food. Zesty was also excellent, and our children really enjoyed it.

The poolside grill was consistently one of the best places to eat during our stay. There was always a good variety of casual favorites such as burgers, hot dogs, fries, wings, chicken fingers, and nachos. The food was consistently good, and the gentleman working the grill deserves special recognition for his patience, friendliness, and hard work.

Antonio at the smoothie bar was also wonderful—always attentive, friendly, and pleasant.

My favorite place in the entire resort was the coffee shop. The ice cream was incredible, honestly some of the best we've had at an all-inclusive resort. The flavors were fantastic, and we visited at least twice a day. The coffee was exceptional every single time, which was a huge improvement from our previous visit. The coffee shop itself is adorable and quickly became our favorite spot. A huge thank you to Alejandro (Alex), Norma, Rosalinda, and Perla for their amazing service and for making the best iced cappuccinos every day.

The beach was unfortunately affected by a significant amount of seaweed during our stay. While the resort did clean it a couple of times during our 9-day vacation, the seaweed returned quickly. The smell made the beach less enjoyable, and we only spent time there once or twice. I understand this is largely nature-related and not entirely within the resort's control, but it did impact our experience, but again, of course this isn’t the hotels fault. 

One of the biggest surprises of our trip was the Kids Club. We have traveled throughout Mexico and the Caribbean many times, and I have never left my children at a kids club before. After visiting the Kids Dome, we decided to give it a try. When I returned to pick them up, my children were upset because they wanted to stay longer! That says everything. Maylin and Gipsy were absolutely phenomenal. They were patient, attentive, caring, and genuinely wonderful with the children. They kept the kids busy with activities and made them feel special. Both of these ladies deserve tremendous recognition for the incredible job they do.

Unfortunately, the biggest disappointment of our stay was the entertainment. Having visited many resorts throughout Mexico, I can honestly say this was some of the weakest entertainment we've experienced. The evening shows lacked energy and excitement, and many guests were leaving shortly after they began. We looked forward to the nightly entertainment but were unable to sit through most of the shows during our stay.

The pool entertainment was also very limited. During our 9-day vacation, there were only a couple of days (2) with organized activities around the pool, and even then they were fairly short and underwhelming, no DJ playing music either. If you're looking for a lively resort with music, activities, and engaging entertainment throughout the day and evening, this may not be the best fit for you.

That being said, the staff are truly the heart of this resort. Nearly every employee we encountered was exceptional. They paid attention to details, worked incredibly hard, and provided excellent service throughout the property. The only negative service experience we had was during lunch at Vibra, where the staff seemed uninterested and quite rude. Aside from that, everyone else was wonderful.

Would I return for a third stay? Personally, no.

While the resort is beautiful, luxurious, exceptionally clean, and staffed by some truly amazing people, the food and entertainment simply did not meet our expectations. Overall, I would rate the food around a 5/10. We've experienced much better dining at other resorts in Mexico, including Royalton and RIU properties. Likewise, the entertainment was a major letdown compared to what we've experienced elsewhere.

I would recommend this resort to travelers who value a beautiful property, a relaxing atmosphere, excellent service, and a fantastic Kids Club. However, if entertainment, lively pool activities, and strong food options are priorities for your family, I would encourage you to carefully read reviews and make sure this resort aligns with your vacation style and expectations.

Despite the areas where we felt improvements could be be made, we are grateful for the wonderful staff who helped make our stay enjoyable and for the many great memories we made as a family.

reviews.author: KChi
reviews.title: Paradisus Blue Agave Alberto
reviews.text:
Alberto at Blue Agave is the best! 
He was able to get a chocolate milk shake for my niece that was not ‘on the menu’.  He was super attentive and is very hospitable.  Thank you, Alberto.

reviews.author: GerAche
reviews.title: A more refined all inclusive
reviews.text: Beautifully remodeled with detailed attention to guests, young and old. We had a birthday celebration weekend and our “butler”, Omar, was outstanding. All questions quickly answered and proactive suggestions and recommendations delivered. The food was very good in all restaurants and lots of fun to be had. I can recommend this place without reservations (I don’t mean the kind you do have to make).

reviews.author: MARIA P
reviews.title: Everything we experienced from this new renovation was very pleasant for us.
reviews.text:
The overall treatment was excellent. Julio, a wonderful bartender in Tower 5 during the evening shift, makes you feel very pampered. He is an excellent person with great attention.
The girls at the pool, especially Cintia, also provided very lovely treatment towards us. The experience we had was the best, and we highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Alejandra  S
reviews.title: Good reception.
reviews.text: Excellent attention and service during check-in.

reviews.author: Kirsten S
reviews.title: Great stay in Cancun
reviews.text: This hotel was perfect for a family vacation (and wedding). Our room was great and very clean. The spa was wonderful and the treatments were fabulous. The staff members were so lovely and accommodating. A few special staff members were Alejander at the Nespresso Cafe, Ava by the pool, and Adan the Concierge. The quality of the food could be improved, but overall it was a great visit to Cancun.

reviews.author: BoyMomTex
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text:
This is our first stay at Paradisus Cancun but have also stayed at the Paradisus Punta Cana. 

You are greeted at the front door with a cool towel and cold fruit drink. Staff is incredibly helpful as they help with bags and checkin process.

Bracelets are your room key and gate to the resort.  

The food was amazing. Restaurants require reservations that you can make downstairs by the buffet. Sometimes we could make them for future days and sometimes not. Not sure what the actual rules were. 

Buffet is really good.

Beds were comfortable. AC in the room went down to 68 at the lowest.  

Open common areas are not climate controlled.  So in the afternoons it is quite hot and humid in there-especially the elevators. Most restaurants are climate controlled.

Public restrooms have washcloths to dry hands

AquaWorld is literally across the street. The front door men will drive you down to the gate in a golf cart.

We had no issues with mosquitos

Umbrellas with chairs at the beach were perfect

A lot of seaweed on the beach.

Each evening there is some kind of show. Sometimes out by the pool. Lighting wasn’t great but it’s entertainment. Also most afternoons some kind of inflatable or activity by the pool.

Would definitely stay again.

reviews.author: avelandiag
reviews.title: The yoga class was very good.
reviews.text: We had two good experiences in yoga class, one by the sea and another meditation class that were quite good. Rogelio and Jesus did an incredible job.

reviews.author: April E
reviews.title: Paradisus lives up to its name!
reviews.text:
Had an amazing time thanks to Carolina and Erick, our concierge! They made my friend and I stay very easy and pleasurable. I was literally able to turn my brain off thanks to them. 
The hotel architecture is beautiful. You really feel like you’re in your own world. My only criticism is when I ordered nachos through room service it was terrible. Chips tasted stale and the food cold.

reviews.author: lilivg0783
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: Vianney, the waitress at the pool, was very kind and provided us with excellent service, thank you! Very clean areas.

reviews.author: WT Goldman
reviews.title: Unparalleled Service and Environment
reviews.text:
This is my third time coming to Paradisus Cancun. It’s by far the best all-inclusive resort I’ve ever been to. I always book their Reserve Adults Only section, it’s very much worth it. 

My butler, Omar Robledo, is among the main reasons I give this resort the highest of ratings. When I return, and I will very soon, I’ll make sure it’s Omar I get as my butler or I’ll walk away lol. 
He was very attentive, always making sure I’m getting the best of what the resort has to offer. Without him I would’ve missed out on plenty of goodies. Thank you Omar!!

A shout out also to other awesome staff members like Ivan and Horacio in the Reserve section that made sure I was well taken care of, along with all the beautiful smiling faces of all Paradisus staff always greeting you as you walk by. 
An unparalleled experience is what you’ll get in Paradisus.

reviews.author: Ruby T
reviews.title: Ginger Bar
reviews.text: Flor y Andrés from Ginger Bar were great. They were very attentive and were always willing to serve us.

reviews.author: Yochabel M
reviews.title: Experience
reviews.text: Thank you for your accommodation and your attentions, excellent staff

reviews.author: M9558QDphilipm
reviews.title: My summer vacation experience
reviews.text:
Pascqual and Armando at the buffet were amazing. Very helpful. 

Overall the resort has changed. We have been to Paradisus 4 times and this time the overall quality was just average. The food quality and variety was not good. It was the same food every day, salty and bland. We love the staff, but overall we are not happy with the hotel and will not be back. 

Outside the hotel we also noticed the people were not as warm, inviting or friendly. It’s not the Cancún we remember and love.

reviews.author: Sara H
reviews.title: Alberto Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Alberto is the best! He checked us in and it was such a smooth process. Even upgraded our room to a higher floor so we can have a better view! 10/10

reviews.author: Karla O
reviews.title: Exceptional attention from Rodolfo: he made our stay unforgettable.
reviews.text:
I want to highlight and especially thank Rodolfo, the concierge at Paradisus, for the extraordinary attention he provided us throughout our stay.

From the very first moment, he was incredibly kind, attentive, professional, and always willing to help with a smile. It did not matter what we needed or what questions we had; Rodolfo always found a way to resolve it quickly and efficiently, making us feel truly welcomed and valued as guests.

What impressed us the most was his service attitude. It is evident that he enjoys his work and genuinely cares that guests have the best experience possible. Thanks to his dedication, our trip was much more comfortable, pleasant, and special.

People like Rodolfo make a huge difference and represent the best of the hospitality that Paradisus offers. I sincerely hope that management recognizes his excellent work, because employees with that level of commitment, human warmth, and professionalism are hard to find.

Thank you very much, Rodolfo. Without a doubt, you are one of the main reasons we take away such a positive memory of this hotel and why we would love to return.

reviews.author: Edith O
reviews.title: Pleasant
reviews.text: Excellent service, peaceful. The facilities are beautifully designed. Not recommended for the absent-minded. Overall, I liked it.

reviews.author: kord d
reviews.title: Juan Carlos and Alondra are GREAT
reviews.text: We interacted with many staff members during our stays here and we’d like to shine light on Juan Carlos and Alondra. They were fantastic and made our weeklong honeymoon memorable.

reviews.author: Marcelo D
reviews.title: A luxurious rest.
reviews.text:
We traveled with my wife to this resort after 12 years to celebrate our anniversary.
We are members of the Infinity Black Circle, and as such, we enjoyed our stay from the airport where we were picked up in a luxury private transfer.
The hotel is a complex of buildings that resemble Mayan pyramids with numerous pools and a special area for adults, The Reserve, which is quieter.
The highlight is the excellent service at the restaurants, especially. 
The Italian restaurant (Cappella) where I want to highlight the excellent service from Odon and Teresita.
The steakhouse (Sal) with its captain Daniel, an expert in wines, who advised us throughout our stay.
The Mexican restaurant (Blue Agave) with its captain Nathanael, who had us try the liquors and Mexican dishes, and the excellent service from Atiliano.
Vibra, where I want to give special mention to Captain Naxhielly and the waiter Israel.
Sante by the pool, where I want to give special mention for the warmth in the service that made us feel at home to Cinthia, and also to highlight Gemma, César, and Yamil.
To the food managers who were always attentive, Diego Díaz and Adriana.
In the service to the members, Verónica, Rocio, and Estephany.
Only one downside during our stay was Ameyal, who was supposed to be part of our experience and made us have the only bad moment, which does not overshadow the rest of the staff who truly make you feel and enjoy like in very few places.

reviews.author: Bruno O
reviews.title: Great place to enjoy vacation
reviews.text:
We had an amazing experience at Paradisus hotel. Such a beautiful place to stay, good restaurants, close to the beach and Mayan museum. Special thanks to those who made our stay even better:
buffet restaurant: Richer, Alejandro, Rodolfo, David, Martin, Ramiro, Liliana
Lobby: Yesenia
Coffee shop: Anahi
Concierge: Rodolfo Medina
Entertainment: Giovani

reviews.author: Harlem Rocio M
reviews.title: Comfortable facilities
reviews.text: Excellent service, from check-in to check-out.

reviews.author: Iveth R
reviews.title: Excellence
reviews.text: Quality in service and attention

reviews.author: Yenny P
reviews.title: The shows should last longer; overall, I was pleased with the attention.
reviews.text: The spaces were very clean, and the food was good as well.

reviews.author: Robert L
reviews.title: WIFES 50TH BIRTHDAY CELEBRATION
reviews.text: My wife and I love Paradisus Cancun and this was our 1st time staying in The Reserve Adult Only section and it was outstanding.  The staff are professional and attentive to all guest needs and wants. Our Concierge Estephany was great ensuring all of our wants and needs were taken care of.

reviews.author: Shannon c
reviews.title: A Beautiful Anniversary Trip with Exceptional Service
reviews.text:
My husband and I celebrated our 20-year anniversary at Paradisus Cancun in April 2026, and we had a wonderful experience.

The resort had recently reopened after renovations, and everything felt fresh, modern, and very clean. The beach was beautiful, the pools were relaxing, and the grounds were well maintained.

The highlight of our stay was the staff. Everyone was friendly, helpful, and genuinely seemed to care about making our vacation special. A special thank you to Chris, our Reserve Concierge, who went above and beyond throughout our stay.

If you’re considering upgrading to The Reserve Adults Only section, I highly recommend it. The concierge service, exclusive lounge, premium drinks, coffee bar, adults-only dining, and Bali beds were well worth it.

The resort offers several dining options, including steak, seafood, Japanese cuisine, and a buffet. While the food wasn’t our favorite part of the trip, breakfast was excellent and there was plenty of variety.

We especially enjoyed the live saxophone music during breakfast, the beautiful beach, and the peaceful gym each morning.

Overall, we had an amazing anniversary trip and would gladly return to Paradisus Cancun in the future.

reviews.author: Litzely G
reviews.title: Experience
reviews.text: Excellent service from the waiter Atilano at the Blue Agave restaurant, all the attention from the entire staff, Erich also made the stay special!!!

reviews.author: pettrey
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
The resort has gone downhill from my first visit. I have stayed there 4 times now over 8 years. I pools were dirty, the skimmers weren’t working as was told by the staff. 
Now, the bar staff was EXCELLENT. All of the bars that I visited were extremely helpful. We were told
that the resort was at 25% capacity and they were hiring/training new staff.

reviews.author: kudzayi c
reviews.title: The experience was wonderful.
reviews.text: The service we received was impeccable. The staff was warm and welcoming. All our needs were met. Special thanks to the staff including Alejandro, Richer, Edgar, Jose, Ernesto, Oswaldo,  Eric, Ernesto, Pascal, Hermes, Vivney, Tony, and all other staff that were ever smiling and kind to us. I will definitely come back again.

reviews.author: Rodrigo V
reviews.title: Very good service and a beautiful place.
reviews.text:
We had a very good stay at the hotel, mainly due to the attention of the staff. The facilities are beautiful, but undoubtedly what stands out the most is the quality of the team.

We want to especially thank Rodolfo, our concierge, who was always attentive and willing to help; Julio from the Reserve area for his cheerfulness and excellent service; and also Daniel, Leo, and Ignacio from the Sal restaurant, which was by far our favorite restaurant. The food was very delicious, but the experience was even better thanks to them. We also want to highlight Roberto from Zesti for his kindness.

However, we felt that the beach was disappointing due to the amount of seaweed and because we hardly saw any cleaning during our stay. Additionally, at Santé we had the worst experience: very slow service (we waited about an hour and a half on the first day) and food that was considerably weaker than the rest.

Aside from that, we are leaving very happy. The service at this hotel truly makes a difference.

reviews.author: Elizabeth L
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: Had a great trip! Food was good, pool was great, staff was very helpful especially Julie from guest services. The property is beautiful and well maintained.

reviews.author: richay3896
reviews.title: Excellent time at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: My wife and I enjoyed a week at the recently renovated Paradisus Cancun.  The hotel is fabulous, all new furniture, an updated gym, new and updated restaurants, and best of all a staff that excels at service.  We were impressed with the food, the chefs are excellent.  Our concierge (Rodolpho) was always there to help with reservations and answer questions - he managed last minute changes/updates with ease.  We will definitely return to Paradisus Cancun - this is one of our favorite resorts.

reviews.author: Cori
reviews.title: Ask for Atilano!
reviews.text: Our waiter Atilano was fantastic. He was attentive and very friendly. He greeted us with a smile and made sure to refill our guacamole 🙂. He made sure our experience at blue agave at paradisus cancun was great. I would request him the next time we eat there.

reviews.author: Bri
reviews.title: Family holiday
reviews.text:
Vianney and Tania service at the pools where amazing 
Alejandro and Perla at the cafe service was very good aswell. 
Felt very looked after by these members of staff  and they went out of their way to make our experience a good one.

Food in the buffet could be slightly better

reviews.author: hschroeder
reviews.title: We had the most amazing dinner with Armando. He made so many excellent recommendations!
reviews.text: Armando is amazing. He is full of joy and his recommendations for our meal were fantastic

reviews.author: Linette G
reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.text: We had the best time with my family and 2 grandchildren. The hotel is so beautiful and very committed to sustainability and nature. The people were absolutely amazing, friendly and kind. I especially want to say a few words about Rodolfo our concierge. He was incredible and was there for us for everything we needed. He couldn't do enough for us.

reviews.author: Davidbru12
reviews.title: Great vacation at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Great time - great service 
Armando at the Blue Agave restaurant was outstanding. The food was good bu he was excellent.
Alejandro in the cafe and Alejandro in the buffet are two of the best customer service people you will ever meet!

reviews.author: Risiro 猫
reviews.title: Sal Steake Cave
reviews.text: Excellent and very delicious food, especially the cuts of meat; the service from Paola and Roger in the restaurant, and Rommel helped us with the restaurant reservation, highly recommended and exquisite.

reviews.author: Donna G
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: My daughter and I visited the beginning of May for a week and the service here is absolutely outstanding. Rebecca with the concierge’s was absolutely amazing and helped us every time we saw her walking around the hotel. They  made our bed every day and turned it down every evening. Even though we happened to be there during the seaweed time it did not smell, and they kept the beach as clean as they could.

reviews.author: Pamela Dariana P
reviews.title: The hotel is good, 9 out of 10.
reviews.text: The service from Ignacio is among the best, along with the guy from the Oriental and Paola, the incredible hostess.

reviews.author: Deidryd Rebeca Á
reviews.title: Incredible customer service and beautiful accommodation.
reviews.text:
Every corner of the hotel and the room is incredibly beautiful! 
The attention from the staff is incredible; they are super attentive and caring at all times, from the moment we arrived until our departure. 
The buffet food is delicious. We dined at Lemon Fish Asian and also at Aqua Marina where the view is beautiful; I loved their fish-themed napkins. I believe the manager of Food and Beverage is Jesus Miranda, and his assistant, Adriana Sánchez, provided us with an amazing service!! Adriana is a very kind and helpful person; you will love her; she supported us at all times with everything we needed, making our stay and meals wonderful; they do everything with love! 
We loved every place in the hotel, so much so that my son did not want to stop playing and swimming! 
I highly recommend it; customer service, food, activities in the water and at night, create a magical vacation, and the hotel's natural beauty is wonderful! 
They will love going with family or friends because it is suitable for everyone and for all tastes! 
Thank you for these lovely vacations that you made us have! We will return!

reviews.author: olivia f
reviews.title: We had a great time, thank you Paradisus Cancún for everything.
reviews.text: Everything was very beautiful, and our stay was very pleasant thanks to the concierge Alejandro, who was always very attentive to our needs, the Sal restaurant staff were all very attentive, and the dinner was wonderful. Thank you Alejandro for everything, and Paradisus hotel is one of the best. We will return soon.

reviews.author: Karen C
reviews.title: Exit restaurant
reviews.text:
Everything was incredible, great experience. 
We were lucky to be attended by Ignacio, and everything was incredible

reviews.author: Cristina R
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: We went for a family vacation, the hotel is beautiful and the service we received was even better! We were so glad we got Estephany as our concierge she did everything possible to make our stay very pleasant. We truly appreciate her making sure we had a great time.

reviews.author: Maserai M
reviews.title: Pleasant place
reviews.text: The overall service is good, and I liked the variety of food. I recommend the place.

reviews.author: Departure783880
reviews.title: I highly recommend Paradisus Cancun.
reviews.text: This is an excellent option for your vacation; it is a hotel that meets all the standards of quality, service, cleanliness, and flavor. Kindness and dedication are evident in David from the Kao Japanese restaurant; it is also very complete and delicious. Come to Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: Liz
reviews.title: Good times!
reviews.text: Had a great time back, since their closure last year due to renovations.  Some changes were noticed like their lobby area, rooms appear smaller than before with some changes, the AC needs improvement, 68f was the coolest.  Snacks/food area in the reserve area/adults only area was better before with more options.  No changes were noted in the adults only area, before closing we were told an infinity pool was in the works for this area, disappointed not see this be.  With it just being reopened, staffing is short, we had to wait awhile for most restaurants for food to be delivered, the cabana beds also took awhile, only 1 person, taking care of guests, where as before there  was always 2 people working that reserve area.  Over all had a pleasant time, Estephany our personal concierge was great! She made sure we had everything we needed and more. She went above and beyond helping us to celebrate an anniversary and birthday.  We had nice dessert surprises at dinner and back in our room with special wine,  champagne and room decorations!  Thank you  Estephany for making our stay special, we appreciate you!  Look forward to coming back.

reviews.author: Juan
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun is a place to return to.
reviews.text: Excellent hotel. Excellent service, personalized attention from every employee in all areas. Excellent and varied meals in all the restaurants and buffet. The room was magnificent, with exceptional cleanliness. I must emphasize that Vianney, the waitress in the pool area, is charming, helpful, and very attentive. Workers like these are what make the hotel a more pleasant place, not to mention Edgar, their supervisor. Definitely, Paradisus Cancun is a place to return to.

reviews.author: mummyoffive
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Just leaving after an amazing week hotel has been renovated and is immaculate staff very attentive Ana who was a server around the main pool is an absolute credit she never stopped and welcome everyone every day we used Gastro hall for meals plenty of choice and beautifully cooked in many visits to Mexico this has been the best Thankyou Melia

reviews.author: Relax631849
reviews.title: Great atmosphere and service, beautiful resort.
reviews.text: Great service and beautiful resort, I highly recommend it. At the Gastro Hall buffet, great atmosphere snd superb service from Candelario, Seferino, Reynaldo, Armando, and Diego! Thank you guys for making my family feel like kings and queens.

reviews.author: Dario Rodríguez
reviews.title: Long live the Mexican
reviews.text: Atilano from the Mexican restaurant is an excellent host. The food is delicious, the service is unbeatable.

reviews.author: Andrea H
reviews.title: Pool bingo was great
reviews.text:
The poolside bingo was great, I won a prize. It was a lot of fun and Uriel and Mauricio were great hosts.

Great entertainment here at Parasidus.

reviews.author: Tourist44515132242
reviews.title: Would not return
reviews.text: Stunning hotel but boring. Food is not very good. Nothing to do as soon as the sun goes down. Very spa like and quiet

reviews.author: Jel Sko
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: Fantastic place for families. Alberto was great!

reviews.author: lamiller111
reviews.title: Great trip
reviews.text: We recently spent a week at this resort. It is vastly improved over a trip we took early last year before the remodel. We are circle members and have been members of Melia for around 15 years. Our concierge, Rodolfo’s outstanding. Our Grandkids 5 and 7 loved the kids club and the water zone pool. Our favorite restaurants were Sal, Sante, cappellas and Kai. Many of the staff are new since the reopening and were getting up to speed but all were friendly and eager to assist us with any need. We will definitely be back soon.

reviews.author: ronyx77
reviews.title: Paradisus review
reviews.text:
Very friendly and courteous staff. Rooms could use a bit more planning especially with in room amenities 
Our concierge Natalie made sure all our needs were taken care of. Horacio & Antonio took care of us by the pool. Gastro Hall had plenty of choices for all ages

reviews.author: Alan Miguel B
reviews.title: Birthday of little Khalid.
reviews.text:
I visited the Paradisus Cancun hotel to celebrate the birthday of the little one in the family. From the moment we arrived, we were warmly welcomed and directed to reception, where Andrei and Alberto, along with Joshua from the rooms controller area, greeted us. They were very attentive and took care to personalize the experience at all times. They asked us if it was our first time visiting the property and if we were celebrating any special occasion, and without any expectations, we received a free upgrade to two rooms on the upper floor with an ocean view, as well as a complimentary late check-out. Joshua invited us to start enjoying the property while they finished up some details in the rooms. 

At lunch, we visited the Blue Agave restaurant, where we were attended by Xóchitl, who was very attentive and helpful at all times. 
Shortly before finishing, the reception team informed us that our rooms were ready. Upon arriving at the room, we found a very nice birthday decoration along with other amenities and a personalized card that we absolutely loved. 

It was a great experience at the property; we enjoyed the facilities, restaurants, pool area, and the new water park zone, and above all, we loved feeling pampered and very well received by the entire Paradisus Cancun team.

reviews.author: Santa Maria M
reviews.title: Quality welcome.
reviews.text: The reception was excellent. They offered us a wet towel and drinks upon arrival, which we greatly appreciated after the trip. My children were very tired and restless, and they had the lovely gesture of bringing them ice cream, which made them very happy. Alan was extremely kind, patient, and attentive throughout the entire check-in process. They made us feel very welcome from the very first moment.

reviews.author: Laura G
reviews.title: Incredible.
reviews.text: Incredible experience... the hotel was clean, and the kids' section had very good and safe attention, which was pleasant for the little ones! The caregiver Vianey was very kind and conveyed a lot of trust.

reviews.author: Kelly M
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: We totally recommend Paradisus; we had a wonderful family vacation, the hotel staff is very friendly, the kids' area is excellent for children, Alondra is a lovely person, the kids fell in love with her, they had a great time, and Omar at the reception was super friendly and attentive! Do not hesitate to come to Paradisus.

reviews.author: Gmiller5374
reviews.title: Great Resort Amazing Staff
reviews.text:
We just returned from a 7 night stay at Paradisus Cancun.  My wife and I wanted to come back after the renovations were completed this year after an amazing stay in March of 2025.  All I can say is that the resort is great and the staff is amazing.  We will be back again and again with our next trip already planned for later this year.  We were blown away by the attention to detail and the fact that many of staff remembered us from our last stay.  Restaurants were all very good.  Food in general was all very good.  Drinks were aplenty and served quickly.  Entertainment was available as well.  Zestys was a very warm atmosphere (temp wise) Blue Agave was very accommodating, Pizza ok, coffee shop great, ice cream place great, buffet not so great.

Amazing People....Not in order

Julio is amazing
Ceasar is amazing
Alejandro is amazing
Valentina is amazing
Gemma is great
Yamil is great
Jesus is great 
David is great (last day 5/20/26)
Mickey Mouse (they know) is great
Donald Duck (they know) is great

Please know that many travelers to this resort come from outside of the USA and do not tip (part of their culture), but the amazing people in this resort deserve a little attention.  They give you their undivided attention while you are there to make your stay amazing so please consider a tip to show your appreciation.  While not expected it is well received as they work very hard for everyone that is there tips or not.

reviews.author: Maricruz I
reviews.title: Magical place.
reviews.text: The hotel is incredible and the attention from everyone was wonderful; since we checked in, they treated us very well, the facilities are very nice, we loved that they maintain that part of nature and elegance at the same time, we dined at the Asian restaurant and it was delicious, the buffet was very varied with many healthy options for all tastes, the assistant Diego took very good care of us and was always attentive to us, we also dined at Agua Marina and we loved it; the captain Teresita took very good care of us, we especially highlight the attention of the food and beverage manager, Mr. Jesus Miranda, and his assistant Adriana Sanchez for all the facilities and the charisma they have in performing their work; it is evident that they do it with great passion. In the pool area, the waiter Rodrigo and his boss Luis were also very helpful and attentive, and the captain Grecia was very kind and attentive. Everyone was very nice and attentive, and they made our stay unforgettable. Thank you so much to the entire Paradisus team!!! We hope to return very soon!!
